messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — prod-eu /v1/generate 5xx spike (8% over 5m). Runbook: deploy_turbulence. Paging #incidents and oncall

maria: I'm oncall. Noticed spike right after the 22:40 deploy. Errors are mostly 503 from inference-gateway, a few model loader OOMs reported. Rolling variant traffic looks suspicious.

ashwin: looking now — the rollout moved ~35% traffic to variant 'v2-int8-relaxed' at 22:39. gpux-12 nodes showing model load latencies and transient OOMs. Could be quantized model edge case.

sam: +1 on rollback. Suggest flip feature flag to stop routing to v2-int8 and shift back to stable v1. Maria, can you assess customer impact while I coordinate the flag flip?

maria: Customer impact: elevated timeouts for EU customers, roughly 8-12% error rate for a subset of paid customers on EU region. CS notified and prepping a message. No data corruption, just request failures/timeouts. ETA 10m for action.

ashwin: preparing manual rollback. Command I will run: ```
redwood flags set route_v2_int8 0 --env prod-eu
redwood traffic shift --from v2-int8 --to v1-stable --percent 35 --env prod-eu
```

deploy-bot: Incoming action — scheduled traffic shift request from ashwin at 22:44 UTC. Approvals: sam.

sam: go ahead. Maria, please run the quick smoke after the flip: curl against health-check and run a small load to confirm 5xx < 1% and p50 latency normal. If not, escalate to full rollback (drain + scale up v1).

maria: flipping flag now. Will post status updates.

maria: ```
# ran at 22:44:12 UTC
redwood flags set route_v2_int8 0 --env prod-eu
# immediate traffic shift triggered
```

incident-bot: Audit log: flag route_v2_int8 set to 0 by maria at 22:44:12 UTC. Traffic rebalancer initiating drain of v2-int8.

ashwin: seeing model loader errors drop on gpux-12. Metrics: 5xx went from 8% -> 1.2% within 90s. Still watching p95.

maria: running smoke script: ```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.prod-eu.redwood/v1/generate; done
# results: mostly 200s, a couple 504s early, now stable
```

sam: good. Wait 2 more minutes to ensure stabilization. If 5xx stays <1% and p95 latency within SLO, we close. ashwin, plan for next steps to prevent recurrence?

ashwin: yes — will revert quantization flag in CI for that model, add extra memory headroom on gpux-12, and schedule a canary with slower ramp next week. File a patch to model loader to catch this edge case.

customer-success: CS update — drafting a proactive note to affected EU customers, confirming service degraded but now mitigated, mention ongoing follow-up and postmortem.

maria: 5xx at 0.6% for last 3m, p95 back to baseline. No further errors in logs tied to v2-int8. Marking incident mitigated.

sam: thanks. I'll create a brief incident page and assign a postmortem to ashwin + maria. Night team handoff to jen for monitoring until tomorrow morning. jen, pinged you for awareness.

jen: ack, I'll monitor the dashboards overnight and escalate if anything resurfaces.

maria: Closing on-call thread. Follow-ups: (1) ashwin to ship fix + canary plan, (2) CS to send customer note, (3) postmortem doc. Tagging incident resolved. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: noted — will open PR and schedule controlled canary with 5% increments over 30m next week.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 22:49:23 UTC. Duration ~9m. Metrics back to normal.
